capabilities: Open CSV and TSV files as table views
Filter and sort rows without changing the file
Edit cells, rows, and columns and save back to the file
Copy and paste ranges with Excel, Word, and tab-separated text
Export filtered rows to a new CSV
extras: The interface localizes to Japanese, English, and German; the plugin is not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the author accepts donations via Buy Me a Coffee; it deliberately does not open .xlsx or .docx files and does not convert between CSV and TSV.
problem: Obsidian opens CSV and TSV files as plain text, so there is no built-in way to view, filter, sort, or edit them as tables.
summary: CSV and TSV table viewer and editor that opens .csv/.tsv files as sortable, filterable tables and lets you edit cells, rows, and columns.
